_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); analog semiconductor signals; the listing and short-history bounds rules (AVGO)

pit_profile.why: Avago: 'We are a leading designer, developer and global supplier of a broad range of analog semiconductor devices with a focus on III-V based products', 'We serve three primary target markets', and 'We operate a primarily outsourced manufacturing business model' (its own FY2012 10-K); 'The global semiconductor market is highly competitive', and 'We operate in the highly cyclical semiconductor industry, which is subject to significant downturns': a cyclical and competitive risk, not an obsolescence one

classification.quality_note: Avago: 'We are a leading designer, developer and global supplier of a broad range of analog semiconductor devices with a focus on III-V based products', 'We serve three primary target markets', and 'We operate a primarily outsourced manufacturing business model' (its own FY2012 10-K); 'The global semiconductor market is highly competitive', and 'We operate in the highly cyclical semiconductor industry, which is subject to significant downturns': a cyclical and competitive risk, not an obsolescence one. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price fair; Ratio B 0.17x; +36% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +0.15; conservative 2yr -10%.

BEAR.desc: EPS +0.0%/yr (worst year FY08-FY12 ex-FY09, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS -3.6%/yr (Q3 FY13 guide YoY + margin + buyback); P/E at its 3.7-yr ex-FY09 median

BULL.desc: EPS +71.5%/yr (FY08-FY12 ex-FY09 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +155.0%/yr (best 2-yr run FY08-FY12 ex-FY09, at least BULL); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: AVGO (retrospective, 2013-07-26) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.17x (30.3% downside to Bear $25.65 / +179.0% upside to Bull $102.61) | Adj composite 2.10 vs market 1.95: gap +0.15 [FAIRLY VALUED] | +36% above the EPP floor $27.00 (12x FY13E $2.25) | Conservative 2-yr case: -9.7% total (-4.8%/yr) | At 16.3x FY13E the 15% hurdle price $48.64 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; net revenue -2.6% YoY in Q2 FY13, forward revenues -1.7% to +1.1% (Q3 FY13 revenue guide (guidance 8-K)); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
